text: For every finite number n of qubits and every n-qubit density operator rho, let S_n={sigma_i} be the finite set of pure n-qubit stabilizer states. The robustness of magic R(rho) is the minimum of sum_i |x_i| over real coefficient vectors x satisfying rho=sum_i x_i sigma_i.
If E is a trace-preserving stabilizer channel, then for every pure stabilizer state sigma_i there are coefficients p_{i,j}>=0 with sum_j p_{i,j}=1 such that E(sigma_i)=sum_j p_{i,j} sigma_j.
For every n-qubit density operator rho, R(rho)=1 if and only if rho is a mixed stabilizer state; otherwise R(rho)>1.
For every n-qubit density operator rho and every trace-preserving stabilizer channel E whose action on each pure stabilizer state is a convex mixture of pure stabilizer states, R(E(rho))<=R(rho).
